name: Bucinnazine
summary: Bucinnazine (AP-237, 1-butyryl-4-cinnamylpiperazine) is an opioid analgesic drug that was widely used in China to treat pain in cancer patients as of 1986. It is one of the most potent compounds among a series of piperazine-amides first synthesized and reported in Japan in the 1970s. Bucinnazine has analgesic potency comparable to that of morphine, but with a relatively higher therapeutic index.

uses.text: Bucinnazine (AP-237, 1-butyryl-4-cinnamylpiperazine) is an opioid analgesic drug that was widely used in China to treat pain in cancer patients as of 1986.

summaryZh: 布桂嗪是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式為C17H24N2O，可作為一種類阿片鎮痛藥，20世紀70年代在日本首次合成，1986年起在中國廣泛用於緩解癌症患者的疼痛
summaryZhHans: 布桂嗪是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式为C17H24N2O，可作为一种类阿片镇痛药，20世纪70年代在日本首次合成，1986年起在中国广泛用于缓解癌症患者的疼痛

pharmacology.en: It acts on the mu-opioid receptor, the same target as morphine. Activating that receptor dampens pain signals and also slows the brainstem centres that control breathing.
pharmacology.zh: 它作用於 μ 鴉片受體，與嗎啡標的相同。活化該受體會抑制疼痛訊號，同時也減緩控制呼吸的腦幹中樞。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它作用于 μ 鸦片受体，与吗啡标的相同。活化该受体会抑制疼痛信号，同时也减缓控制呼吸的脑干中枢。

sideEffects.en: Like other opioids it causes drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and overdose can be fatal. It has been detected in deaths involving novel opioids, and regular use leads to dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 和其他鴉片類一樣，它會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量可能致命。它曾在涉及新型鴉片類藥物的死亡案例中被檢出，規律使用也會導致依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 和其他鸦片类一样，它会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量可能致命。它曾在涉及新型鸦片类药物的死亡案例中被检出，规律使用也会导致依赖。

fact.en: Known in China as AP-237, it was widely used there for cancer pain. It is a piperazine opioid, a structure quite unlike morphine or fentanyl, and it later appeared on the designer drug market.
fact.zh: 布桂嗪在中國稱為 AP-237，曾廣泛用於癌症疼痛。它是哌嗪類鴉片藥物，結構與嗎啡或芬太尼頗為不同，後來也出現在設計師藥物市場上。
fact.zhHans: 布桂嗪在中国称为 AP-237，曾广泛用于癌症疼痛。它是哌嗪类鸦片药物，结构与吗啡或芬太尼颇为不同，后来也出现在设计师药物市场上。
